text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track progress. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, such as reports or products, should be clearly described so everyone knows what is expected. Finally, stakeholder alignment is necessary to make sure all team members and clients share the same understanding of the project's objectives. When these elements are combined, projects are more likely to stay on track and meet expectations.
